pass.answer: The hook has no OS toast branch on Windows: a fire-and-forget process leaves no live activator host for a WinRT toast.
No os_toast on Windows, because a WinRT toast needs a live activator host and the hook's process is gone at once.
The case statement has no Windows arm, since a fire-and-forget process cannot host the activator a WinRT toast needs.

fail.answer: There is no toast on Windows.
Windows has no toast because BurntToast is not installed.
Windows has no toast because notify-send does not exist there.
The hook has no branch because Windows does not support notifications.
A Windows toast branch exists, but the toggle is off by default there.
